# Films {#sec-films}

The CPS Wikibase distinguishes several film and video types, such as *Super-8 film loop*, *film loop*, *16 mm film* and *video loop*. This chapter groups them together.

```{python}
#| label: setup
from baldessari import cps, plots, table, works_table
films = cps.films()
```

The CPS Wikibase contains **`{python} len(films)`** works of a film or video type.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-films
#| tbl-cap: "Films and video works in the CPS Wikibase."
table(works_table(films))
```

## Film types

```{python}
#| label: fig-film-types
#| fig-cap: "Number of film and video works per type."
film_types = (
    films["types"].str.split("; ").explode()
    .loc[lambda s: s != "artwork"]
    .value_counts().rename_axis("Type").reset_index(name="Works")
)
plots.bar_counts(film_types, "Type", "Works")
```
